body: I no longer think supporting an EditorExportPlugin mechanism for skipping a whole extension makes sense.  The problem is that an EditorExportPlugin that is covering files in an extension is interfering with the GDExtensionExportPlugin that is built-in to the engine.  That plugin will be producing warnings for editor only extensions that aren't excluded using the Resources tab.  These warnings were introduced by commit 2d66988f9936328611ff289c1b330f295a121452.  If the project had to exclude the directories using the Resources tab anyway, there is no need to write an EditorExportPlugin to do the same thing.  There is also no way to guarantee order for export plugins to run (they are run alphabetically at this point in time, but that is undocumented) so having two export plugins skip the same files doesn't make sense.  An export plugin should be reserved for handling its files and their remapping not for excluding another plugins files such as those that are part of an extension handled by the GDExtensionExportPlugin.
